deviation: JDBC health (`DataSourceHealthIndicator`, `DataSourceHealthIndicatorProperties`, `DataSourceHealthContributorAutoConfiguration`) lives in the glue library `flint:boot-jdbc-health` under its Spring names, which the resolver adds whenever `flint:boot-jdbc` and `flint:boot-health` are both resolved (docs/spring/phase1/boot.md)
reason: Flint has no optional dependencies, and `@ConditionalOnClass` asks about the dependency closure, so boot-jdbc cannot depend on boot-health
